# Trainer Notes — Synthetic Press

> Public-safe software validation fixture. These notes are supporting material, not a controlled source.

## Session sequence

- Ask the learner to verify the training label before the simulated pre-start inspection.
- Confirm the guard is closed before requesting trainer release.
- Record the inspection result in the training log.
- If anything is uncertain, stop and ask the trainer; do not guess.

## Evidence and authority reminders

- The approved SOP is the current authority for the synthetic pressure setting.
- The archived deck repeats the PPE guidance but conflicts on the pressure value.
- The equipment photo is illustrative only and does not establish a real device anchor.
- Page, slide, and text-block evidence must remain traceable in the author review package.
